description_html:
The InferenceX team is back after two months. Jordan Nanos (@JordanNanos) is joined by Cam Quilici (@noslawextratost), Bryan Shan, and Alec Ibarra to discuss Engram and DRAM offloading, the AgentX benchmark and its profit calculator, TPU v7 on InferenceX, Vera Rubin vs Blackwell, fast tokens, and TileRT on NVIDIA GPUs.

0:31 Engrams

12:27 AgentX Benchmark

16:36 Profit Calculator

23:40 TPU v7

32:03 Vera Rubin

40:49 Fast Tokens

49:33 TileRT

54:00 Chip Startups

1:01:31 Wrap Up
